top_deficiency_types.title: Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.
Have corridors or aisles that are unobstructed and are at least 8 feet in width.
Have exits that are accessible at all times.
Install smoke barrier doors that can resist smoke for at least 20 minutes.
Have posted "No-smoking" signs in areas where smoking is not permitted or ashtrays provided where smoking was allowed.
Have proper medical gas storage and administration areas.

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.
